name: Chase Bliss
author: Tone Zone
description: Experimental boutique pedals inspired by Chase Bliss: micro-loopers, a looper, glitch and freeze, lo-fi and tape effects, odd delays, analog tremolo / phaser / flanger / vibrato, EQ preamps, dual drives, a compressor and the desktop fader reverb and echo. Colourful art, small knobs, 3-way toggles and working DIP switches.
